SECURITY CHECK: unrelated project's core data never reaches the creator
notes: Page HTTP 200. Underlying /api/projects/34/* calls: [{"url":"http://localhost:3000/api/projects/34/reviews","status":404,"body":{"error":"Project not found"}},{"url":"http://localhost:3000/api/projects/34/cards","status":404,"body":{"error":"Project not found"}},{"url":"http://localhost:3000/api/projects/34","status":404,"body":{"error":"Project not found"}},{"url":"http://localhost:3000/api/projects/34/payments","status":200,"body":{"configured":true,"key_id":"rzp_test_TDMnEwU0s6YqwA"}},{"url":"http://localhost:3000/api/projects/34/stage-entries. Page body snippet: "influnet CREATOR WORKSPACE Home Dashboard Public profile Messages Requests Projects Connections My activity Settings  Welcome back, Madan Gowri  Searc"

Base project record / activity / change-requests / stage-entries / reviews / cards correctly denied (4xx): true. The page now renders a clear "doesn't exist, or you don't have access" state instead of the indefinite "Loading…" spinner the audit found.

/stage-items returned HTTP 500 ({"error":"Failed to seed stage items"}) instead of a clean 403 — the route tries to auto-seed default checklist rows on first GET, RLS correctly blocks that INSERT for a non-participant, but the route surfaces it as a generic 500 rather than catching the specific case and returning 403. No stage data was exposed (the response is an error, not a checklist).

/payments returned HTTP 200 with {"configured":true,"key_id":"rzp_test_TDMnEwU0s6YqwA"} — this is app-wide "is Razorpay configured" config plus its public key_id (meant to be public — used client-side to open Checkout), not this project's actual payment records. Not a leak, but the route still never checked membership before answering.
GET /api/projects/34/reviews as an unrelated creator → HTTP 404, body: {"error":"Project not found"} (was HTTP 200 before the fix).
GET /api/projects/34/cards as an unrelated creator → HTTP 404, body: {"error":"Project not found"} (was HTTP 200 before the fix).
